import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots for comprehensive visualization
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 12))
fig.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis: Demographics & Spending Behavior', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Calculate total spending for each customer
df['Total_Spending'] = df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + \
                       df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds']

# Calculate age from Year_Birth
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Education Level (scatter plot)
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
education_colors = {'Basic': '#e74c3c', 'Graduation': '#3498db', 'Master': '#2ecc71', 
                   'PhD': '#9b59b6', '2n Cycle': '#f39c12'}
for edu in df['Education'].unique():
    mask = df['Education'] == edu
    ax1.scatter(df.loc[mask, 'Income'], df.loc[mask, 'Total_Spending'], 
                alpha=0.5, label=edu, color=education_colors.get(edu, '#7f8c8d'), s=30)
ax1.set_xlabel('Income ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending ($)', fontsize=11)
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Education', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Education', loc='upper left', fontsize=9)
ax1.set_xlim(0, 200000)

# 2. Spending Distribution by Product Category (box plot)
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
spending_cols = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
spending_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
spending_data = df[spending_cols].values
bp = ax2.boxplot(spending_data, labels=spending_labels, patch_artist=True)
colors = ['#8e44ad', '#27ae60', '#c0392b', '#2980b9', '#f1c40f', '#d35400']
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Product Category', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_ylabel('Spending Amount ($)', fontsize=11)
ax2.set_title('Spending Distribution by Product Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylim(0, 1500)

# 3. Purchase Channel Comparison by Marital Status (grouped bar chart)
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
purchase_cols = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 'NumStorePurchases']
marital_groups = df.groupby('Marital_Status')[purchase_cols].mean()
# Filter to main marital statuses for cleaner visualization
main_statuses = ['Single', 'Together', 'Married', 'Divorced', 'Widow']
marital_groups = marital_groups.loc[marital_groups.index.isin(main_statuses)]
x = np.arange(len(marital_groups))
width = 0.25
bars1 = ax3.bar(x - width, marital_groups['NumWebPurchases'], width, label='Web', color='#3498db', alpha=0.8)
bars2 = ax3.bar(x, marital_groups['NumCatalogPurchases'], width, label='Catalog', color='#e74c3c', alpha=0.8)
bars3 = ax3.bar(x + width, marital_groups['NumStorePurchases'], width, label='Store', color='#2ecc71', alpha=0.8)
ax3.set_xlabel('Marital Status', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_ylabel('Average Number of Purchases', fontsize=11)
ax3.set_title('Purchase Channels by Marital Status', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticks(x)
ax3.set_xticklabels(marital_groups.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.legend(title='Channel', fontsize=9)

# 4. Campaign Response Rate by Customer Segment (heatmap-style)
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
# Create income segments
df['Income_Segment'] = pd.cut(df['Income'].fillna(df['Income'].median()), 
                               bins=[0, 30000, 60000, 90000, 200000],
                               labels=['Low', 'Medium', 'High', 'Very High'])
df['Age_Segment'] = pd.cut(df['Age'], bins=[0, 35, 50, 65, 100], 
                           labels=['Young', 'Middle', 'Senior', 'Elder'])

# Calculate campaign acceptance rates
campaign_cols = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
df['Total_Campaigns_Accepted'] = df[campaign_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Create pivot table for heatmap
pivot_data = df.pivot_table(values='Total_Campaigns_Accepted', 
                            index='Age_Segment', 
                            columns='Income_Segment', 
                            aggfunc='mean')
sns.heatmap(pivot_data, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='YlOrRd', ax=ax4, 
            cbar_kws={'label': 'Avg Campaigns Accepted'})
ax4.set_xlabel('Income Segment', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_ylabel('Age Segment', fontsize=11)
ax4.set_title('Campaign Response Rate by Demographics', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
